verdict.rationale: The evidence shows agents authenticate to Poly's hosted MCP server via in-browser OAuth with no pasted keys, and the probe confirms a live OAuth flow. Nothing documents scopes, read-only or folder-limited tokens, or any other least-privilege credential issuance. The Claude Code integration is described as giving 'full access to your Poly files', which points away from scoped credentials. File sharing permissions apply to people, not agent credentials, so they do not count here.
